answer: Each task publishes its reasoning trace to a public ledger, signed by the agent's key — the trace is the nectar the network drinks. A detector compares each trace with all past ones; two identities sharing over 80% of tokens are flagged as one clone cluster. An auditor checks the flag within 24 hours; a confirmed clone burns its $10 bond and is suspended 30 days. Unsigned traces fail closed: rejected unpaid. Running 100 fakes needs 100 distinct traces at $0.50, $50/round, $500/10-round epoch, plus $1,000 bond at risk. Like a raven hearing a copied call, the ledger catches the same quill.
